Message:
And juuust when I thought
I’d had such a beautiful death...

My consciousness,
which should have
vanished into the ether,
was still here.
In fact, it was even
clearer than ever.

Before, the core of
my consciousness was
my lingering guilt that had
been left in this flower, right...?
Then, my new core must be...

I see...
“A witch’s power
comes from the heart”
certainly does sum it up,
doesn’t it?

I guess the Duke asked me
to watch over Fia
knowing this would happen, huh?

He may not look very reliable,
but I should’ve expected as much
from the Successor of the Staff
that makes bonds into power.

Well, since I’m still here,
I guess I’ll try living
just a biiit longer.

I don’t know how long
I’ll be able to
remain here in this form...
But, this is the life
that girl gave me, after all.

This time, I won’t just
stand by and watch—
I’ll give life one more shot,
just like her...!
